query: SELECT message AS "message!: String", ordinal AS "ordinal!: i64" FROM (SELECT message, ordinal FROM span_edges WHERE message = ?1 UNION SELECT message, ordinal FROM senses WHERE message = ?1 UNION SELECT message, ordinal FROM conversational WHERE message = ?1 UNION SELECT source_message, source_ordinal FROM segment_links WHERE source_message = ?1 UNION SELECT target_message, target_ordinal FROM segment_links WHERE target_message = ?1) ORDER BY ordinal
